lastCompletedStory.title: Typed Spec schema + validators in src/issues/spec.ts

nextStoryContext: US-002 created src/issues/spec.ts with the Spec interface (acceptanceCriteria, scope, gotchas, domainTerms) and pure validators validateSpec + validateWsjf (both return { ok, errors }). IssueEntry.spec is now typed as Spec (optional) instead of unknown. migrate-issues-schema.ts was fixed to cast raw.spec correctly (null+undefined guard + as IssueEntry['spec']). Circular type imports between types.ts and spec.ts are type-only (import type) and resolve cleanly. 1762 tests pass, typecheck clean, biome lint clean.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-002 is pure TypeScript interfaces and validators with no external library dependencies.
